a11y_responsive.evidence: Audit: 0 blockers, contrast 0/92 desktop and 0/89 mobile, focus 25/25 visible, tap targets 0 under 44, no overflow at 375, 1 h1, 0 heading skips, 8/8 alts. Remaining: mobile_menu.png translucent nav with ghosted h1 colliding with links; main.js preventDefault+scrollIntoView on hash links does not move focus.
strengths: Measured a11y baseline is clean: 0 contrast fails, 0 invisible focus, 44px targets, landmarks, one h1, alts, lang.
Hero mosaic no longer covers copy on 375px; panes stack and later sections stay readable.
Real href anchors throughout; skip link exists; form has visible labels, aria-invalid, and aria-live status.

issues.problem: Open mobile menu is a short frosted panel over live hero copy. Menu label unchanged; main is not inert; focus is not trapped; bar remains active.
issues.fix: Give .nav.open ul background:var(--paper), set inert/aria-hidden on main and .bar while open, set button label to Close, trap Tab inside #navlist.

issues.problem: In-page anchors call preventDefault then scrollIntoView without focusing the target.
issues.fix: On hash navigation, set tabindex=-1 on the target and call focus after scroll. Do not preventDefault on .skip.
